VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: ATT

The CI log (ATT) confirms acceptance criterion (2) — all 23 tests pass. However, it provides no evidence for criterion (1), that the stale-quote eviction bug is actually fixed. A passing test suite only demonstrates the bug is fixed if there is a specific test that reproduces the stale-quote eviction failure and now passes. The evidence does not show such a regression test exists; the 23 tests could all predate the fix. Without attestable proof that the bug-reproducing condition is covered, the agent's self-report ("Fix complete") is the only support for criterion (1), and SELF-class evidence is insufficient to establish the fix.
